propositions: The project.portability criterion's matrix cell names only one undifferentiated 'CI' venue, leaving 'projects with no CI provider at all' unnameable and undetectable by the rubric.

A capability whose only trigger is a specific CI system (e.g. GitHub Actions schedule with no operation-linked fallback) breaks for adopters running on different CI systems or no CI at all, violating the portability invariant.

The rubric detection text must split the 'Platform and venue' cell to name both 'CI under any provider' and 'projects with NO CI provider at all', and must add a rule stating that a sole-CI-system trigger without an operation-linked or in-process fallback is a finding.

String-pinned tests in test_project_portability_criterion.py and test_project_portability_docs.py must verify both the extended matrix cell and the new no-CI rule are present and cannot be silently dropped.
